title: ICBC Service Plan 2014–2016
publisher: Insurance Corporation of British Columbia / Government of British Columbia
supports: Corporation established in 1973; cover is a separate 2014 example of the rounded badge.

title: CIPO trademark image 903609
supports: Primary official-mark filing and advertised dates for the abbreviated half-disc arrangement.
does_not_establish: A 1989 launch or retirement date; the full-name variant is not separately dated by this drawing.

title: Insurance Corporation of British Columbia — owner index
supports: Lists filing 1989-01-12 for the legacy ICBC design and 1992-03-16 for two other ICBC marks.
does_not_establish: Logo launches. Drawings for the two 1992 filings were not successfully retrieved; they must not be assigned to the serif sample.

title: ICBC & Design — 1326195 / TMA716470
supports: Square-corner, sans-serif road badge in the drawing; insurance-services use claimed since at least March 1992.
does_not_establish: That 2006 was a redesign year, or that the precise 2005 vector geometry was first introduced in 1992.

title: ICBC & Design (rounded corners) — 1379948 / TMA747042
supports: Expressly describes a square with THREE rounded corners, lettering and a curving road. Drawing is reversed out on a display background. Insurance-services use is claimed from at least March 1992.
does_not_establish: An exact public rollout date or an exclusive 1992–present visual era.

title: ICBC & Design (colour) — 1561227 / TMA843300
supports: White ICBC and white curving road on blue; use claimed since at least January 2008.
does_not_establish: A 2012 or 2013 redesign; exact RGB, Pantone or CMYK values.

title: ICBC Annual Service Plan Report 2025/26
supports: Blue rounded road badge still appears on the 2026 official report.
does_not_establish: That an orange website treatment permanently replaces blue.

title: ICBC Trademarks
supports: ICBC controls its marks and describes written-permission requirements for association with products, services and events.
does_not_establish: Permission for this research package or endorsement by ICBC.

title: ICBC Annual Report 2015
supports: Another official example of the blue rounded design.

title: ICBC website — current header
supports: Contemporary website observation, to be considered with the supplied orange SVG and screenshot.
does_not_establish: An orange launch date, permanent rebrand, or a specific commemorative purpose. Current headers on old articles do not date the logo to the article year.

title: ICBC & DESIGN — 0374886 / TMA205097
supports: Early emblem drawing and first-use claim. Hatching denotes colour, not surface texture.
does_not_establish: Exact original colour values, logo retirement or a 1973 launch.

title: ICBC 1992 annual report
publisher: ICBC; scan hosted by McGill University
locator: PDF page 28 of 28, back cover. Print code PI 151 (2 93).
supports: Serif road badge on the report; print code is consistent with February 1993.
does_not_establish: The precise launch day of the serif drawing or every road-logo detail.

title: ICBC 2007–2009 Service Plan
supports: Square-corner sans badge in a dated publication.

title: ICBC 2008–2010 Service Plan
supports: Older square-corner sans badge still appears.

title: ICBC 2009–2011 Service Plan
supports: Rounded geometry in a dated publication.
does_not_establish: An exact 2009 adoption date; earlier colour use is claimed by S5.

title: ICBC Branding / Brand Owner’s Manual
supports: Credits a brand manual and related communications work for client Wasserman+Partners.
does_not_establish: That Ross designed the original logo, or a reliable project launch year.

title: ICBC rebrand case study
supports: Prior follow-up research described purple, lozenge labels, signage and digital applications around the road badge.
does_not_establish: A new logo era or verified introduction date.
retrieval_status: Anti-bot interstitial on package recheck; prior reported observations retained as a lead, not fresh verification.
